source_revision: Apple Open Source Darwin xnu-10002.1.13 (macOS 14.0 Sonoma / iOS 17)
hardware_target: iPhone 15 / iPhone15,4 / D37AP / Apple A16 Bionic T8120

initialization_call_chain.function_purpose: CPU reset entry, DAIF interrupt masking, MPIDR core affinity query, FP/SIMD access enable, SP_EL1 setup
Primary Everest core bootstrap handoff; passes boot_args in X0 to arm_init
Machine-dependent initialization coordinator; calls PE, VM, pmap, and transitions to machine_startup
Platform Expert dispatcher; validates boot_args and invokes PE_init_platform
Parses DeviceTree, identifies AIC2 controller aperture, stores platform state in g_pe_state
Constructs initial 16KB Stage-1 multi-level page tables, fixes AIC2 Level-2 32MB block mapping, invalidates ghost RAM slot 1
Determines physical DRAM bounds (0x0 - 0x800000), stolen boundaries (avail_start=0x40000), sets pmap_initialized=1
Populates pmap_phys_attributes table (512 entries at 0x28020) tracking modified/referenced/managed state
Allocates and initializes xnu_page_metadata_header_t (0x28000) and 496 xnu_vm_page_t descriptors (0x28220)
Initializes kernel virtual memory map (kernel_map), creates submaps, enforces guard pages
Initializes kernel fixed-size object zone allocator (zalloc) for tasks, threads, ports, and VM entries
Initializes multi-level priority run queues (32 priorities), idle thread, and scheduler quantum ticks
Creates kernel_task (PID 0) associated with kernel_map, initializes task list
Creates initial kernel execution thread (TID 1), allocates kernel stack, establishes ARM64 register context
Coordinates handoff to first schedulable kernel thread, enables timer and AIC2 interrupts, enters scheduler loop

unmodified_c_compilation_blockers: Mach-O link script requirement for unreferenced Darwin macro symbols
Full Mach IPC port hash table and audit session infrastructure
BSD VFS vnode layer dependencies prior to kernel_task initialization
blocker_analysis.mitigation_strategy: Implement Category B adapted C functions preserving exact Darwin field offsets, data structures, and algorithms, verified by reading guest memory directly.
